why: The other half of the same line, and the half a player never sees: `?dev=1&quality=low` silently does nothing, so the on-device sweep issue #113 defers -- the reason the flag exists at all -- reports whatever the machine's saved preference happens to be. The natural edit once a setting exists ('the setting is the source of truth now'), and wrong because a flag that must not write the player's save has no other way to be honoured.
killedBy: startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default threads the quality dev flag through to the renderer
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default lets ?dev=1&quality= OVERRIDE the stored preset, without writing it
